name: Tooyama Asuka
source:
Asuka was saved from drowning by Kazuya when she was a child, and she has thought about him ever since and dreamed of being his bride. She affectionately calls him Ka-chan.

Club activity: Tennis club.
Hobbies: Taking care of the protagonist.
Special skills: Making lunch for the protagonist.
Relation: Childhood friend of the protagonist.
Bust: 108 --> 114 cm.
Cup size: N --> P

Belongs to [url=/c4281]Kaoru[/url]'s group of friends.
